node.question: In the edited image, is the same woman's jacket fully closed, with no visible opening remaining along its front closure?
node.criteria: Pass only if the visible closure itself shows the panels meeting with no opening. Fail only if an opening along the closure is clearly visible; panels appearing separated solely because the jacket flares with the turned pose is not sufficient. Unknown if pose, drape, or occlusion prevents judging the closure itself.
node.binding: Assess the same woman's jacket. Inspect the edited image's front closure, distinguishing a visible opening along the closure from outward flare or silhouette caused by pose and drape. Full closure is required; partial closure is not complete fulfillment. Use the source only to identify the garment, not to infer the edited endpoint.
